title: Python Input, Arithmetic, and Debugging
prerequisites: Ability to type and save a plain-text file
Access to the teacher-assigned Python editor for live code runs
objectives: Trace keyboard input, numeric conversion, variables, arithmetic, and labeled output.
Classify syntax, name, type, and logic errors and correct one cause at a time.
Build and test a short calculator with saved code and repeatable test records.

requirements.account: No account required for module practice
requirements.storage: Progress remains in this browser and device
requirements.offline: Trace and correct the printed Python programs, then complete the input-process-output and test tables.

formalAssessment: Separate teacher directions and rubric are required.
